objective: Prove that on a closed surface with a Kasteleyn law in a class no state satisfies, learning at the dissonance with the state fixed resolves a least state's pair of opposite charges, leaving no even face, and that every resolving walk's sign change is a cycle of nonzero homology class; check it by replaying walks into every other class on the Fano tori and the thin tori of even index up to 40 points; compute walk costs against the systole and a local rule's success (E1-E5); and test the sphere's no-reversal rule one size past (S).
status: Proved 2026-11-09 (by hand; finite claims checked; costs and local rules computed; pre-registered): only surfaces with Euler characteristic 0 can be free of dissonance; on a class-forced torus a least state's dissonance is one violated line and one fully agreeing face, learning at the dissonance with the state fixed resolves the pair leaving no even face, and every resolving process, whatever the state does, changes the law around a handle (a cycle of nonzero class). Checked: 96,732 walks on the two Fano tori and 57 thin tori of even index up to 40 points reach every other class. Computed: the cheapest walk into each class meets the cycle bound exactly; a local rule with an outside distance resolved 9,608 of 9,608 starts, against the pre-registered expectation. Stress test of the sphere's local rule passed one size past.
title: Learning resolves a class-forced pair only by winding
